deadline.value: The page gives a June 1 deadline and a January 15 date for financial aid, but no year.
deadline.quote: We accept applications by June 1 of each year for admission in the following fall term.

gre_general.value: The GRE is not required, but the department highly recommends submitting it.
gre_general.quote: The GRE is not required to apply, but it is highly recommended

gre_subject.value: The page does not mention a Mathematics or Statistics subject test.

supervisor.value: A faculty supervisor is identified during the first year of the PhD, not before admission.
supervisor.quote: By the end of your first year, you will identify a faculty member who is willing to supervise your Ph.D. research.

funding.value: The page does not describe PhD funding.

entry_route.value: A master's is not required to apply directly to the PhD, though the department recommends one.
entry_route.quote: It is not required to have a M.S. or M.A. to apply directly to our PhD program.

notes: The page says the PhD is for fall admission only. Ph.D. applicants are told to list potential mentors on the application.
